summary: Gerdau S.A., a Brazilian steelmaker, furnished a Form 6-K containing its 2Q26 earnings release and presentation. The filing reports quarterly results: adjusted net income of R$ 1.5 billion (+45% QoQ), adjusted EBITDA of R$ 3.4 billion (+16% QoQ), and free cash flow of R$ 237 million. It notes a share buyback program (31% executed, ~R$ 334 million, 0.9% of outstanding shares), a share cancellation, dividends, and increased energy self-generation via a stake increase in Dona Francisca Energética. The filing contains routine operating results, capital allocation updates, and outlook commentary, with no special-situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or going-private proposal.
